products.name: AIDE Technology Platform (Drug Encapsulation in Autologous Red Blood Cells)

products.name: eDSP (Drug-Encapsulated Steroid Product)

products.name: Phage-Based Therapeutic Products

products.name: Injectable Corticosteroid Gel for Sciatica (SEMDEXA/SP-102)
products.description: A novel, viscous gel formulation of dexamethasone sodium phosphate for epidural injection to treat lumbosacral radicular pain (sciatica), manufactured as a sterile injectable and distributed through specialty pharmaceutical channels (pending FDA approval).

products.name: Delayed-Release Low-Dose Naltrexone Capsules for Fibromyalgia (SP-104)
products.description: A novel, low-dose, delayed-release oral capsule formulation of naltrexone hydrochloride for the treatment of fibromyalgia, manufactured by contract and intended for prescription distribution (pending FDA approval).

products.name: Cryptocurrency Treasury and Yield-Generating Activities
products.description: Acquisition, holding, and management of cryptocurrencies (bitcoin, Ethereum, BNB, Doge, and others) as a long-term treasury asset, including staking and related yield-generating activities, managed via third-party custodians and asset managers.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a broad range of loans and lines of credit to businesses, including commercial and industrial loans, commercial real estate loans, commercial construction loans, and asset-based lending. These are delivered through in-person relationship management and digital channels, requiring significant financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Small Business Lending
products.description: Offers loans and lines of credit to small businesses, including SBA 7(a) loans, with exposures typically under $1 million. Delivered through both traditional underwriting and automated decisioning, leveraging digital and in-person channels.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Provides mortgage loans for the purchase or refinancing of one- to four-family residential properties, including both conforming and non-conforming loans. Loans are originated for both portfolio retention and sale on the secondary market, with processing and underwriting partially outsourced.

products.name: Home Equity Lending
products.description: Offers home equity loans and lines of credit secured by residential property, typically with cumulative loan-to-value ratios up to 80%. Delivered through branch and digital channels, requiring credit underwriting and collateral evaluation.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provides unsecured and secured personal loans, including personal lines of credit, overdraft protection, automobile loans, and other consumer loans. Delivered through branch and digital channels, requiring credit evaluation and compliance with consumer protection regulations.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offers a range of deposit products to consumers and businesses, including demand deposit accounts, interest checking, money market accounts, savings accounts, and time certificates of deposit. Delivered through a branch network and digital banking platforms, requiring regulated infrastructure and FDIC insurance.

products.name: Wealth Management and Trust Services
products.description: Provides wealth management, investment management, trust, and fiduciary services to individuals, businesses, and institutions. Services include portfolio management, financial planning, and serving as trustee or personal representative, delivered through specialized divisions and requiring licensed professionals and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Cash Management and Treasury Services
products.description: Offers cash management solutions to corporate, institutional, and municipal clients, including automated lock box collection, account reconciliation, and other treasury services. Delivered through specialized teams and digital platforms, requiring integration with client financial systems.

products.name: Bloom Energy Server (Solid Oxide Fuel Cell System)
products.description: A proprietary high-temperature solid oxide fuel cell system that converts fuels such as natural gas, biogas, and hydrogen into electricity onsite using a non-combustion electrochemical process. Manufactured in the U.S. and South Korea, it is delivered as modular, scalable units for deployment at customer sites, supporting applications from primary power generation to microgrids and combined heat and power.

products.name: Bloom Electrolyzer (Hydrogen Production System)
products.description: A solid oxide electrolyzer system that uses electricity and high-temperature steam to produce hydrogen onsite, leveraging the same platform as the Energy Server. It is manufactured using shared supply chain and processes, and is designed for industrial, transportation, and power sector applications requiring scalable, efficient hydrogen production.

products.name: Operations and Maintenance (O&M) Services
products.description: Long-term service agreements for monitoring, maintaining, and operating installed Bloom Energy Server systems, including 24x7 remote monitoring, scheduled and unscheduled maintenance, and predictive analytics. Delivered through dedicated service teams and remote monitoring centers, these services ensure system availability and performance over contract life.

products.name: Routine Clinical Laboratory Testing
products.description: Comprehensive menu of frequently ordered laboratory tests (e.g., blood chemistry, urinalysis, blood cell counts, thyroid, infectious disease) performed in primary and specialty labs, delivered via a national network of patient service centers and in-office phlebotomists. Requires physical specimen collection, regulated laboratory infrastructure, and rapid digital reporting.

products.name: Specialty and Esoteric Laboratory Testing
products.description: Advanced, gene-based, and disease-specific laboratory tests in areas such as oncology, women’s health, autoimmune disease, neurology, cardiovascular, genetics, and pharmacogenetics. Delivered through specialized labs using advanced technologies and scientific expertise, supporting precision medicine and clinical decision-making.

products.name: Consumer Health and Wellness Testing
products.description: Direct-to-consumer health and wellness laboratory tests (e.g., health screenings, at-home and on-site testing, vaccinations) offered through digital channels and patient service centers, enabling consumers to order and receive results independently. Delivered via digital platforms and physical collection sites.

products.name: Central Laboratory Services for Clinical Trials
products.description: Global laboratory services supporting clinical trials, including specimen collection, testing, logistics, data management, and digital reporting for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device companies. Delivered through a network of central and specialty labs with robust logistics and digital tools.

products.name: Early Development and Preclinical Research Services
products.description: Preclinical research services including lead optimization, bioanalytical testing, safety assessment, and chemistry manufacturing for drug and biologic development. Delivered by multidisciplinary teams in specialized labs, supporting pharmaceutical R&D from discovery through regulated studies.

products.name: Companion Diagnostics (CDx) Development and Commercialization
products.description: Development, validation, and commercialization of companion diagnostics (CDx) to support targeted therapies and precision medicine, including regulatory support and integration with drug development. Delivered through scientific expertise, regulatory compliance, and global laboratory infrastructure.

products.name: Technology-Enabled Laboratory Data and Analytics Solutions
products.description: Digital and analytics platforms for providers, payers, and patients, including digital pathology, clinical decision support, test selection tools, and patient-facing applications. Delivered as software and digital services integrated with laboratory operations and reporting.

products.name: Occupational, Toxicology, and Drug Testing Services
products.description: Laboratory testing services for employment, occupational health, toxicology, pain management, and medical drug monitoring, including SAMHSA-certified drug testing for public and private sector employers. Delivered through certified labs and regulated processes.

products.name: Crop Protection and Chemical Testing Services
products.description: Consulting and laboratory testing services for chemical manufacturers and firms developing crop protection technologies, including safety and efficacy assessments. Delivered through specialized labs and scientific consulting teams.

products.name: Handbags and Bags
products.description: A wide range of women's handbags and bags, including backpacks, totes, crossbodies, lunch bags, satchels, clutches, and baby bags, designed and developed in-house and manufactured using various fabrics such as cotton, leather, and nylon. Products are distributed through retail stores, e-commerce, and wholesale channels.

products.name: Travel Products
products.description: Travel-related products including rolling luggage, duffel and weekend bags, cosmetics cases, and travel and packing accessories, featuring Vera Bradley's signature designs and lightweight fabrications. These are manufactured through global partners and sold via multiple channels.

products.name: Fashion Accessories
products.description: Fashion accessories such as ID holders, lanyards, wallets, wristlets, eyewear, technology accessories, and bag charms, designed in-house and produced by third-party manufacturers, sold through direct and indirect channels.

products.name: Home Products
products.description: Home textiles and accessories, including throw blankets, beach towels, mugs, and tumblers, featuring Vera Bradley's signature prints and patterns, produced via manufacturing partners and licensing agreements.

products.name: Apparel and Footwear
products.description: Apparel and footwear items such as sleepwear, outerwear, slippers, and socks, designed under the Vera Bradley brand and produced through manufacturing partners and licensees.

products.name: Licensed Products
products.description: Products manufactured and sold by third parties under licensing agreements, including eyewear, bedding and bath textiles, sleep and loungewear, stationery, drinkware, and co-branded items with partners such as NFL, Disney, and NCAA.

products.name: Scheduled Passenger Airline Service
products.description: Low-fare, high-quality scheduled passenger flights primarily serving leisure and VFR travelers, using a flexible capacity model and a fleet of Boeing 737-NG aircraft. Service includes non-stop flights to popular destinations, with ancillary options such as baggage, seat selection, and on-board sales.

products.name: Charter Airline Services
products.description: Ad hoc, short-term, and long-term charter flights for organizations such as the Department of Defense, collegiate and professional sports teams, and casinos, using narrow-body Boeing 737-NG aircraft. Includes VIP charters with specialized configurations and regularly scheduled VIP services.

products.name: Cargo Airline Services (CMI for Amazon)
products.description: Contracted cargo flights for Amazon using Boeing 737-800 freighters, where Sun Country provides flight operations, crew, maintenance, and insurance, while Amazon supplies aircraft and covers many operating expenses. Service is asset-light and focused on Amazon's U.S. domestic network.

products.name: Vacation Package Services (SCV Products)
products.description: Bundled vacation packages that combine Sun Country flights with third-party hotel rooms and rental cars, facilitating one-stop booking for customers. Delivered digitally via the company's website and app, generating commissions from third-party providers.

products.name: Co-branded Credit Card Program
products.description: A co-branded credit card that allows customers to earn loyalty points redeemable for flights and ancillary products, supporting customer retention and generating revenue through commissions and financial partnerships.

products.name: Hepatitis C Virus (HCV) Protease Inhibitors (MAVYRET/MAVIRET)
products.description: Small molecule antiviral drugs, discovered by the company and out-licensed to AbbVie, used in fixed-dose oral combination regimens for the treatment of acute and chronic HCV infection. These are manufactured and commercialized by AbbVie and sold globally as MAVYRET/MAVIRET.

products.name: Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) Antiviral Therapies
products.description: Oral, small molecule direct-acting antivirals targeting RSV replication, including N-protein (zelicapavir) and L-protein (EDP-323) inhibitors, developed through internal chemistry and delivered as once-daily oral treatments for high-risk pediatric and adult populations. These are in clinical development and may be partnered for commercialization.

products.name: SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19) Antiviral Therapies
products.description: Oral, small molecule 3CL protease inhibitors (e.g., EDP-235) designed to treat COVID-19 and potentially other coronaviruses, developed internally and delivered as once-daily oral treatments. These are in clinical development and may be out-licensed or partnered for further advancement.

products.name: Hepatitis B Virus (HBV) Antiviral Therapies
products.description: Oral, small molecule core inhibitors (e.g., EDP-514) targeting HBV replication, developed internally for the treatment of chronic HBV infection, with the goal of combination regimens for functional cure. These are in clinical development and may be out-licensed or partnered.

products.name: Immunology Small Molecule Inhibitors (KIT and STAT6 Inhibitors)
products.description: Oral, small molecule inhibitors targeting immune response mechanisms (KIT and STAT6 pathways) for the treatment of type 2 inflammatory diseases such as chronic spontaneous urticaria (CSU) and atopic dermatitis (AD). These are in preclinical and early clinical development, with candidates like EDP-978 (KIT inhibitor) and EPS-3903 (STAT6 inhibitor).
